Team — RK Logistics Leadership

# Operators, not consultants.

 RK is led by people who have spent their careers inside mission-critical supply chain operations. The leadership team brings decades of discipline from the highest-stakes manufacturing floors in the world — and carries that standard into every customer program RK runs. 

 Seven hundred-plus supply chain professionals. One operating standard. 

700+

## The operators running the operation.

Chairman, CEO & President Joe MacLean

Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and President of RK Logistics. Leads strategy, customer relationships, and the company's next chapter of growth across high-technology logistics and advanced mobility.

Chief Operating Officer James Bryant

Chief Operating Officer. Runs RK's multi-facility operation day to day — quality, safety, customer delivery, and the operating discipline that underpins every program.

Chief Financial Officer David Blandford

Chief Financial Officer. Leads finance, capital planning, and commercial strategy across RK's operating companies. Drives the discipline that lets RK invest ahead of customer growth.

Chief Commercial Officer Peter O'Donnell

Chief Commercial Officer. 25+ years in logistics operations, sales management, and integrated supply chain solutions. Leads RK's go-to-market strategy, customer engagement, and the business development organization that expands RK's footprint across the innovation economy.

Head of Innovation Center Taylor Froiland

Heads the RK Innovation Center. Responsible for applying AI, automation, and integrated supply chain technology to every customer program — the team that builds what RK runs.

## The team you'll meet before the first program ships.

 Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, RK's Directors of Business Development cover the U.S. innovation corridors — Silicon Valley, the Northeast, the Southeast, and the industrial mid-Atlantic — and the verticals that depend on mission-critical 3PL+: EV, semiconductor equipment, energy storage, data center, industrial, and field service. Every named operator on this page is reachable directly. 

Director, Business Development Mike Powell

Director of Business Development based in the Bay Area. Owns customer-facing engagement on new and expanding programs across Silicon Valley — the first call for supply chain leaders evaluating RK against incumbents, with operational accountability through stand-up.

Director, Business Development Brian Dunleavy

Director of Business Development covering the East Coast. 20+ years as a business strategist for the global high-technology industry, with deep expertise in industrial, data center, and energy logistics serving the AI infrastructure boom.

Director, Business Development Craig Leifeld

Director of Business Development based in the Atlanta metro. 25+ years of enterprise business development experience helping leading manufacturers design high-performance warehousing, fulfillment, and reverse logistics solutions — with a focus on Texas and Southeast innovation corridors.

Director, Business Development Paul Palmieri

Director of Business Development with 10+ years of supply chain and contract logistics expertise. Senior business development executive with prior VP-level roles in contract logistics; leads complex, consultative engagements with Fortune 1000 manufacturers across industrial, retail, and healthcare verticals.

## Leaders across every RK service line.

 Each RK service line is run by a dedicated leader with operational accountability for its customers, its metrics, and its growth. 

W2W

Warehouse to World Global Freight Forwarding

Leads RK's global freight forwarding and customs brokerage practice — ocean, air, and cross-border freight for high-technology customers worldwide.

Freight Brokerage Domestic Capacity Management

Leads domestic over-the-road and intermodal capacity sourcing for RK customers — a vetted carrier network held to the same operational standard as every other RK service.

Tri-State Freight Less-Than-Truckload & Regional

Leads RK's tri-state LTL and regional freight operation out of Long Island — less-than-truckload, regional freight, and time-definite delivery across the New York / New Jersey / Connecticut corridor.

Spare Parts & Field Service Mission-Critical Service Parts

Leads the spare-parts and field-service-support operations serving RK's capital-equipment customer base — the multi-decade practice at the heart of the company's origin story.

FTZ & Customs Foreign Trade Zone Operations

Leads RK's Foreign Trade Zone operations — duty-deferred and duty-eliminated handling integrated with customs brokerage and the Innovation Center Control Tower.

Quality & Safety Operational Excellence

Leads RK's quality and safety programs across every facility — the discipline that keeps the company at six-sigma+ quality through cycles, expansions, and customer growth.

> We hire for character first. The skills we will teach you.

## The team behind the operating standard.

 Behind the leadership: 700-plus warehouse operators, supervisors, leads, drivers, and support professionals. They are the people who turn every customer commitment into an outcome. RK invests in their training, career progression, and safety because that is the moat in this business. 

### Operators on the floor

Trained to RK's six-sigma+ quality standard. Hazmat-certified where the work requires it. Promoted internally and celebrated publicly when they get it right.

### Supervisors and shift leads

Most of RK's supervisors started on the floor. The career ladder is real — and the company's institutional memory lives with the operators who have walked every rung of it.

### Account & program managers

Dedicated program leadership for every major customer engagement. Same team, same rhythm, same standard — engagement after engagement.

### Drivers & transportation

Class-A CDL drivers, LTL operators, and specialty transport professionals. White-glove is a discipline, not a slogan.

### Quality, safety, & compliance

A dedicated team making sure the six-sigma+ standard is continuously measured, audited, and improved.

### Innovation Center team

Engineers, operations analysts, and systems specialists building the technology that the rest of the team runs on.

results.title: RK Logistics Group Promotes James Bryant to Chief Operating Officer
results.author: RK Logistics Group
results.text:
RK Logistics Group Promotes James Bryant to Chief Operating Officer

RK Logistics Group 

Sep 24, 2024, 13:30 ET

 

 James Bryant brings 16 years of logistics and supply chain management experience to his new role as RK's chief operating officer. 

16-year logistics veteran to head RK's networkwide operations, oversee some 17 locations in five states with over 400 employees providing a broad range of supply chain services.

FREMONT, Calif., Sept. 24, 2024 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- RK Logistics Group, a leading provider of high-value logistics services and sustainable supply chain solutions for innovation industries, today announced that James Bryant has been promoted to Chief Operating Officer.

In his new role, Mr. Bryant will oversee RK's network-wide operations, comprising some 17 logistics and warehousing sites with nearly 400 employees. He is responsible for strategic planning and operational execution, leading RK's team in providing consistent, high-value logistics services and customer support for RK clients nationwide.

James is a proven leader whose experience and expertise have been fundamental to RK's growth and customer success. This promotion recognizes his accomplishments, and his potential to drive further growth in industries that require innovative logistics solutions -- Joe MacLean, CEO, RK Logistics

"James is a proven leader whose experience and expertise have been fundamental to RK's growth and customer success," said Joe MacLean, RK's chairman, chief executive officer and president. "This promotion recognizes his accomplishments, and his potential to drive further growth across industries and customers we serve in California, Michigan, Texas, New York and Arizona, as well as expansion into new and emerging industries that require innovative logistics solutions."

Founded in Silicon Valley over 30 years ago, RK specializes in high-performance, zero fault tolerance logistics for industries including industrial, semiconductor and automotive manufacturing, EV/lithium-ion battery storage and transport, hazardous materials and consumer goods. The company also provides retail product inventory management, store-door fulfillment, eCommerce order fulfillment, reverse logistics and dedicated/specialty transportation services.

Mr. Bryant has some 16 years of experience in logistics and supply chain management. He was previously RK's vice president of California operations, overseeing a dozen local facilities. He also was primarily responsible for the LAM Research account, a complex logistics support program that integrates multiple logistics services and sites. This solution provides LAM operations with inbound product receipt and put away, warehousing, inventory and order management, local freight transportation, manufacturing line-side fulfillment and spares/emergency field parts support.

Mr. Bryant joined RK in 2013, and previously was director of logistics for a grocery store chain. Following a six-month 3PL training regimen, he was promoted to site manager, subsequently advancing through increasingly responsible management positions, successfully leading some of RK's most demanding projects. While working for RK, he took advantage of the company's tuition reimbursement program to earn a master's in supply chain management and operations from Michigan State University. He subsequently earned his Six Sigma Green Belt from the University of California-Los Angeles. He is certified as the designated representative for RK's license as a third-party logistics provider from the California Board of Pharmacy to handle pharmaceutical products.

Mr. Bryant succeeds Rock Magnan, a 40-year logistics industry veteran who joined RK Logistics in 2011, and recently retired after more than eight years as RK's president.

RK Logistics provides warehousing, transportation and related supply chain management services to companies in leading industries through a network of facilities principally in Northern California, as well as in Michigan, Texas, New York and Arizona. RK's California facility footprint includes sites in Fremont, Hayward, Newark and Livermore, California. Overall, the company operates some 1.7 million square feet of warehousing.

For more information about the company's services or to inquire about partnering with RK Logistics Group, please visit http://www.rklogisticsgroup.com.

ABOUT RK LOGISTICS -- RK Logistics provides sustainable supply chain solutions for innovation industries. RK's expertise is in complex, high value density, zero fault tolerance, regulatorily intensive products that often require comprehensive services. We offer warehousing, specialty transportation, reverse logistics, manufacturing support, engineering support, hazardous materials storage, handling and transportation and order fulfillment. RK's manufacturing support, warehousing, eCommerce order fulfillment and transportation services feature enabling technologies, skilled, experienced teams, lean practices, ISO-9001 and CA Board of Pharmacy 3PL certifications, delivering flexible, sustainable, and efficient logistics solutions. For more information, go to http://www.rklogisticsgroup.com

Media Contact

results.author: RK Logistics Group
results.text:
Cindy Traver Named VP Operations for RK Logsitics Group

# Cindy Traver Named VP Operations for RK Logsitics Group

Apr 05, 2018, 16:15 ET

 

 Cindy Traver, VP Operations for RK Logistics Group 

FREMONT, Calif. (PRWEB) April 05, 2018 -- RK Logistics Group, a Silicon Valley leader in third-party logistics (3PL), announced today that Cindy Traver has been promoted to vice president of operations. 

"Cindy has been instrumental in our development, leading our organization's operations through a period of unprecedented growth and expansion," said Rod Kalune, founder and CEO of RK Logistics Group. "This promotion recognizes her strategic contributions to our success and the continued leadership she provides creating value for our customers."

"Cindy has been instrumental to our success, guiding our organization's operations through a period of unprecedented growth and expansion," said Rod Kalune, founder and CEO of RK Logistics Group, a leading provider of supply chain services in the Silicon Valley..

Cindy was previously RK's senior director of operations. As vice president of operations, she today oversees a network of 14 locations in the greater San Francisco Bay Area representing nearly one million square feet of warehousing, with over 700 employees serving over a dozen clients with a broad range of logistics services and solutions.

A seasoned manager with over 20 years of experience in the logistics and transportation industry, Cindy joined RK Logistics in 2015 from Lam Research, a leader in the design, manufacture, marketing and service of semiconductor processing equipment used in the fabrication of integrated circuits. At Lam, she was director of global logistics responsible for strategic design, leadership and day-to-day management of supply chain operations.

Prior to Lam Cindy was the director of transportation for Safeway Inc., one of the largest grocers in the U.S. Her background and skills encompass managing global logistics across all modes of transportation, lean manufacturing and supply chain practices, six sigma and financial accounting.

A privately-held minority business enterprise, Fremont-based RK Logistics Group is a growing local company with over 700 employees. The company operates a network of 14 warehousing centers in the greater San Francisco Bay Area representing nearly 1 million square feet of commercial distribution space for inventory management, manufacturing support and ecommerce fulfillment.

RK is also an industry leader in adopting robotics-assisted order picking and fulfillment technologies, and creating special industry-specific programs, such as sequencing parts into lean production lines at automotive and technology equipment factories, and just-in-time (JIT) deliveries to construction sites.

In addition, RK Logistics is a California Board of Pharmacy-certified 3PL, signifying that the company meets or exceeds state requirements for handling medical devices, controlled substances and sensitive diagnostic equipment for pharmaceutical and high-value biomedical device firms. Only two logistics companies in northern California, 16 in the state, and 35 in the entire U.S. have achieved this distinction.
